SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id;

SELECT loan_id, disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
ORDER BY loan_id;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_id;

SELECT pp.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM person_profile pp
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, op.operating_status
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND op.registered_region = (
      SELECT region_code 
      FROM organization_unit 
      WHERE unit_name = '上海分行'
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT isc.sector_name_zh, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector isc ON isc.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY isc.sector_code, isc.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, isc.sector_name_zh;

SELECT wp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC, wp.product_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(cs.net_capital), 2) AS net_capital,
       ROUND(SUM(cs.risk_weighted_assets), 2) AS risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY net_capital DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(SUM(ab.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON ab.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind IN ('SAVINGS', 'CURRENT')
  AND ab.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id,
       eg.group_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT 
    ind.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 6) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ind.sector_code = op.industry_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
GROUP BY ind.sector_code, ind.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC, 行业名称;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count, ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = dse.institution_id
WHERE dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_records
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
WHERE rse.completion_date IS NULL 
   OR (rse.deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND rse.completion_date > rse.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_records DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ds.loan_id, ds.principal_overdue_days, cg.grade_name_zh, rc.as_of_date
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN (
    SELECT loan_id, as_of_date, grade_code
    FROM risk_classification
    WHERE (loan_id, as_of_date) IN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date)
        FROM risk_classification
        GROUP BY loan_id
    )
) rc ON rc.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ds.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    s.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS violation_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 0), 6) AS violation_ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party payee_party ON payee_party.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = payee_party.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY violation_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on, wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pe.business_date,
       pt.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
       pe.amount,
       ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog pt ON pt.payment_type = pe.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
       ind_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_borrower ON ind_borrower.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ind_target.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount, 
       ah_from.party_id AS payer_party_id, ah_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON acc_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account acc_to ON acc_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = acc_from.account_id 
    AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
    AND (ah_from.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_from.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = acc_to.account_id 
    AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
    AND (ah_to.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_to.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id 
    AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.from_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT s.staff_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party pt ON pt.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = pt.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ind.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN service_operator so ON so.operator_id = p.operator_id
JOIN staff_member s ON s.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY s.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, s.staff_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT cdd.record_id, i.institution_name, cdd.event_date, cdd.deadline_date,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cdd.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, cdd.record_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    cl.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    ca.status AS 抵押物状态,
    sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY cl.security_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.agreement_id, sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rn AS balance_rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
) ranked
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ranked.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    s.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 本金余额,
    rn AS 排名
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        op.industry_code,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY op.industry_code 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
) t
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = t.industry_code
WHERE t.rn <= 3
ORDER BY s.sector_name_zh, t.rn;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_previous
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(avg_bal.avg_principal, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON lbs2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON avg_bal.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, i.institution_name, ld.loan_id;

SELECT sa.security_id,
       sa.secured_amount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
    ELSE '360天以上'
  END AS overdue_interval,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY MIN(
  CASE 
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END
);

SELECT cl.collateral_id, cv.valued_on, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id, cv.valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cl.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 2) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC, p.display_name
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ou.unit_name, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS employee_count, 
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ou.unit_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH account_holder_latest AS (
    SELECT ah.account_id, ah.party_id, ah.holder_role
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
      AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
),
payment_with_org AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        COALESCE(a_from.institution_id, a_to.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_party_id,
        ah_to.party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account a_from ON pe.from_account_id = a_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account a_to ON pe.to_account_id = a_to.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder_latest ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder_latest ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
),
related_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
      AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rp.source_party_id IS NOT NULL THEN pwo.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pwo.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rp.source_party_id IS NOT NULL THEN pwo.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pwo.amount), 0), 6) AS related_ratio
FROM payment_with_org pwo
JOIN institution i ON pwo.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN related_pairs rp ON pwo.from_party_id = rp.source_party_id AND pwo.to_party_id = rp.target_party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id IN (
    SELECT ah.account_id FROM account_holder ah WHERE ah.party_id = p.party_id
)
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_aging_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_aging_days DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
) ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_code,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(i.sector_name_zh, '未知行业') AS industry_name,
    ROUND(r.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(r.running_total * 1.0 / r.grand_total, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN industry_sector i ON i.sector_code = r.industry_code
WHERE r.running_total * 1.0 / r.grand_total <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS outstanding_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY outstanding_loan_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount AS latest_valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)
  AND cv.valuation_amount > sa.secured_amount * 2
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY institution_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date AS transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, account_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS guarantee_count, ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1 AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ld.drawdown_type
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS 机构平均余额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS 超出差额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON lbs2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) inst_avg ON inst_avg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2 * inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY 超出差额 DESC;

WITH non_related_agreements AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id,
           SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
        WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
total_agreements AS (
    SELECT institution_id,
           SUM(contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0), 2) AS non_related_amount,
       ROUND(ta.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / ta.total_amount, 6) AS non_related_ratio
FROM total_agreements ta
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ta.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_agreements nra ON nra.institution_id = ta.institution_id
ORDER BY non_related_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name,
    p.party_id, p.display_name,
    cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC, i.institution_name, p.display_name
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS execution_rate,
       ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS industry_avg_rate,
       ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate, 2) AS premium_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.target_industry_code,
           AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    WHERE ca2.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND ca2.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca2.target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_rate * 1.10
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY premium_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS 超限客户数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.currency_code = ld.currency_code
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > cs.net_capital * 0.1
ORDER BY 超限客户数 DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_limits AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        gl.exposure_group_id,
        gl.group_name,
        gl.net_capital,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM group_limits gl
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = gl.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id 
        AND ca.institution_id = gl.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gl.exposure_group_id, gl.group_name, gl.net_capital
)
SELECT 
    exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    group_name AS 集团名称,
    ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(total_balance * 1.0 / net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM group_exposure
WHERE total_balance > net_capital * 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date > ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY days_between ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
        AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
)
SELECT institution_name, customer_name, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id
        ) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) AS cnt
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
quartiled AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN rn <= CEIL(cnt * 0.25) THEN 1
            WHEN rn <= CEIL(cnt * 0.50) THEN 2
            WHEN rn <= CEIL(cnt * 0.75) THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END AS quartile
    FROM ranked_loans
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM quartiled
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    lb.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_total.total_principal, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lb2.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_id = lb2.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    WHERE lb2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) inst_total ON inst_total.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    ratio_percent DESC,
    lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
       ld.status,
       ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
       COUNT(ds.loan_id) AS overdue_period_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(ds.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_period_count DESC, total_overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 该日放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 该日放款借据笔数 DESC, ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
INTERSECT
SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
FROM credit_agreement ca
ORDER BY party_id;

SELECT sm.person_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
      AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC, security_id;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY 
  CASE bucket 
    WHEN '常态' THEN 1 
    WHEN '临期' THEN 2 
    WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 
  END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id,
       COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC, ca.collateral_type;

WITH repayment_counts AS (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS cnt
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id 
            ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN repayment_counts rc ON rc.repayment_account_id = ld.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    cnt AS repayment_count
FROM ranked_loans
JOIN repayment_counts USING (repayment_account_id)
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id, disbursed_on;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 合同金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS 账户数量,
       ROUND(SUM(ABS(ABS(bs.ledger_balance) - ABS(bs.available_balance))), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON bs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ABS(bs.ledger_balance) > ABS(bs.available_balance)
  AND (ABS(bs.ledger_balance) - ABS(bs.available_balance)) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC;

SELECT a.account_id, td.opening_principal, td.maturity_on, td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_payment_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING entrusted_ratio < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 90
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
          NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 完成率 > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) < COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT pi.instruction_id,
       ld.loan_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       payee.display_name AS actual_payee_name,
       ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT rs.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       COUNT(*) AS 未结清期次数,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = 'PAID'
)
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.account_kind, ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
       ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
       ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
       p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca2.institution_id,
        ca2.product_family,
        AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_annual_interest_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.institution_id = ca.institution_id 
          AND avg_rate.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate
  AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
      FROM party_relation pr
      JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
      WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
        AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
  )
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC, p.display_name;

SELECT pr.source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
       pr.target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
       rtc.relation_name_zh AS 关联关系名称
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca1
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld1 ON ld1.agreement_id = ca1.agreement_id
      WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca2
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
      WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
    AND SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON from_acc.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON to_acc.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON 
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
    OR (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payee.party_id, payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, 付款方姓名, 收款方姓名;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT ph.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot ph
WHERE ph.investment_path IN ('SPV', 'NESTED_SPV')
GROUP BY ph.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, ph.product_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT 
    op.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca2 WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = p.party_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guarantor_commitment gc2 WHERE gc2.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id)
GROUP BY p.party_id, op.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT sm.staff_id, sm.person_party_id, COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS contract_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, sm.person_party_id
ORDER BY contract_count DESC, sm.staff_id;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
       so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
       so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
  AND ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC, p.display_name;

SELECT p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
       ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
       ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
       ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_family AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ld.drawdown_type
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_family
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, lpc.product_family;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) AS expired_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' 
                AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > '2026-06-30' 
                AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') > 90 THEN 1 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = acc.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account_holder
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT party_id) >= 2
) jh ON jh.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS 逾期笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    COUNT(*) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_installments,
       ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installments DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS 逾期贷款数
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 逾期贷款数 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC, loan_id, installment_no;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_facility_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT cf.facility_id, cf.limit_amount, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC, cf.facility_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    facility_type AS 授信类型,
    COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM (
    SELECT wp.product_id,
           wp.actual_raise_amount,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY wp.actual_raise_amount DESC) AS bucket
    FROM wealth_product wp
    WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
) t
WHERE t.minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY bucket
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY bucket ASC;

SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT pm.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(*) AS pending_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON pm.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pm.payment_mode, pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_count DESC, pm.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT it.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称, sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY it.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
    AND sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
    AND sa.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
WHERE ou.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    d.principal_overdue_days AS 本金逾期天数,
    d.overdue_principal AS 逾期本金
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = d.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = d.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 30
    AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS 覆盖不足借据笔数
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.provision_stage = '2'
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 覆盖不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.required_amount - pr.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口合计
FROM provision_snapshot pr
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pr.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE pr.required_amount > pr.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 拨备缺口合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, b.ledger_balance
FROM account a
LEFT JOIN account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id
      AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ma.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

WITH personal_credit AS (
    SELECT 
        cf.obligor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    GROUP BY cf.obligor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    pc.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(pc.total_limit, 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(pc.total_limit * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM personal_credit pc
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = pc.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 0
  AND pc.total_limit * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, pc.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT pc.status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT pt.payment_id AS 交易编号,
       pc.card_id AS 银行卡编号,
       pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
       pt.business_date AS 交易日期,
       ROUND(pt.amount, 2) AS 交易金额
FROM payment_event pt
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pt.from_account_id
WHERE pt.payment_type = 'CARD_PURCHASE'
  AND pt.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pt.is_cash = 0
ORDER BY pt.amount DESC, pt.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS cash_txn_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY COUNT(pe.payment_id) DESC, SUM(pe.amount) DESC, pc.holder_party_id;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT ctc.name_zh AS 银行卡类型名称,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY ctc.card_type, ctc.name_zh
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, ctc.name_zh ASC;

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT t.account_id, t.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT c.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
       c.asset_label AS 抵质押物名称,
       MAX(v.valuation_amount) AS 最高评估价值
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN collateral_valuation v ON v.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(v.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 最高评估价值 DESC;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, COUNT(*) AS 引用次数, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联担保合同数
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 引用次数 DESC, cl.collateral_id ASC

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.agreement_id
),
guarantee_commitments AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.security_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount,
        so.agreement_id
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    gc.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS 实际放款总金额
FROM guarantee_commitments gc
JOIN loan_totals lt ON gc.agreement_id = lt.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, gc.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信合同金额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 保障缺口
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ca.contract_amount > COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 拨备不足借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 拨备不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 贷款余额,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= 4 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND rc.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM risk_classification rc2 WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id)
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_code, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, 机构名称 ASC, 五级分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS internal_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS external_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND cv.valuation_type IN ('INTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL')
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 资产名称,
    ROUND(latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 最新评估价,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0), 2) AS 累计质押额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) - latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    WHERE valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    )
) latest_val ON latest_val.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, latest_val.valuation_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) > latest_val.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id THEN gc.guaranteed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id THEN gc.guaranteed_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id THEN gc.guaranteed_amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT p.customer_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    egc.name_zh AS 中文敞口组类型名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egc ON egc.group_type = eg.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
