GROUP BY i.institution_name, egc.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC, i.institution_name, egc.name_zh;

SELECT egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, egm.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id AS 关系编号,
    pr.source_party_id AS 关系一方主体编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关系另一方主体编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS 一主体现有借款合同数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS 另一主体现有借款合同数
FROM party_relation pr
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca1 ON ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) > 0 
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC, pr.relation_id;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    gt.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(gt.total_guaranteed, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(blb.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(gt.total_guaranteed - COALESCE(blb.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_totals gt
JOIN party p ON gt.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_loan_balances blb ON gt.guarantor_party_id = blb.borrower_party_id
WHERE gt.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(blb.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC, gt.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(g.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    g.status
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON g.security_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
  AND g.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ma.asset_name AS 底层资产名称,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS 最终债务人编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY SUM(so.covered_amount) DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (cl.collateral_id IS NOT NULL OR gc.commitment_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id 
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '关联客户型'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
       wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
       ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
       COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT cl.collateral_id,
       COUNT(*) AS 第一顺位有效记录数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 超过百分之六十记录数
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 超过百分之六十记录数 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, f.total_assets, f.total_liabilities, f.net_assets, f.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY f.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(f.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / SUM(f.total_assets), 4) AS debt_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot f
JOIN institution i ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY debt_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, 
       ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS 营业收入,
       ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 WHERE fs2.source_kind = 'BANK'), 6) AS 占比
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE fs.source_kind = 'BANK'
  AND fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 WHERE fs2.source_kind = 'BANK') > 0.15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT ma.valuation_method, ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS 开户笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC, ou.unit_name;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount 
                   THEN (p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) 
                   ELSE 0 END), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount 
                   THEN (p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) 
                   ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 6) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount 
                THEN (p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) 
                ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id AS 机构编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 不良借据笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(fs.annual_revenue), 0), 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets AS 风险加权资产,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT pi.payment_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pi.payment_mode;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(f.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value) * 100.0 / c.net_capital, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = p.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot c ON c.institution_id = p.institution_id 
    AND c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id
    AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, c.net_capital, f.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject_id) AS overdue_record_count,
       ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_ledger_balance,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.institution_id = r.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.subject_id) >= 25
ORDER BY provision_gap_amount DESC;

WITH governance_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records,
        SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exception_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount,
        ROUND(AVG(ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
    FROM governance_control_record_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    gs.exception_amount,
    gs.avg_ratio
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN governance_stats gs ON gs.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, gs.exception_amount, gs.avg_ratio
ORDER BY gs.exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 r
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = r.subject_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, p.display_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.event_code IS NOT NULL AND o.exception_flag = 1 THEN o.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS op_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.record_id) AS op_risk_record_count
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 o ON o.institution_id = i.institution_id AND o.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY op_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pc.record_id) AS product_conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pc.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM product_conduct_event_v3 pc
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pc.institution_id
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.issuer_institution_id = pc.institution_id 
    AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
WHERE pc.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pc.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS issued_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cor.record_id) AS custody_active_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cor.exception_flag = 1 THEN cor.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount_total
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 cor ON cor.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
    AND cor.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cor.exception_flag = 1 THEN cor.record_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY issued_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
